The '''Infinite Army''' was an attempt by the [[Order of Revan]] to fuse [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] technology with living beings, in a process developed on [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]] by the [[Selkath/Legends|Selkath]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Gorima]], to create [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] soldiers with rapid healing abilities and other powers. The Order of Revan's production facilities on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lehon/Legends|Rakata Prime]] were [[Raid on Rakata Prime|destroyed]] by intruders and thus the Infinite Army was destroyed.
